subject.title: feat(ui): identity settings and own-identity chip

question: Does the existing gateway user-profile write authorization intentionally permit an authenticated user to edit only their own durable display name and avatar through this new Control UI surface?
rationale: The branch introduces a new user-facing entry point to existing identity write RPCs, while the supplied prerequisite summary describes those RPCs as scope-protected; the intended self-service authorization boundary must be confirmed by the owners of the identity program.

options.title: Confirm self-service profile editing
options.body: Confirm that the existing write scope is deliberately available to the authenticated user’s own durable profile, then proceed once real UI proof is attached.

options.title: Require a narrower self-profile capability
options.body: If current write scope is administrative, add a server-enforced own-profile operation or capability before exposing display-name and avatar controls.

recommendation.title: Confirm self-service profile editing
recommendation.body: Confirm that the existing write scope is deliberately available to the authenticated user’s own durable profile, then proceed once real UI proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the preceding merged profile and identity-resolution surfaces and is best placed to clarify the intended authorization contract.
